notice: New wider-backdrop comparison: each Before keeps the furniture pilot; each After adds civic arcades, planted terraces, market canopies and low rim gardens across the real Commons deck. Review-only. The earlier native download below contains neither art pilot. S3/S5 and production propagation remain pending. This establishes civic extent; broad pale floor and repeated distant fronts remain visible work in progress, especially Astern. Further connected planting and paving are still needed for the concept’s richness.

downloads.title: macOS S3 layout playtest · earlier build without pilot furniture
downloads.note: Unzip and open the app. This is an ad-hoc signed, unmerged developer preview. Cold native ship/title startup checked with fresh settings and bundled AILANGv0.54.18. Tab walks to bridge consoles, E uses the lift/ladder/hatch,7/9 select Bow/Astern. Commons surfaces and coloured find markers are greybox placeholders; review routes and views before detailed art. The new lived-in art pilot is currently shown in the engine images above, not installed in this earlier download.
